name: Plankton
desc: Bioluminescent sea-sparkle igniting in dark water — dinoflagellate points flash cyan-green as an unseen wake sweeps through them, over a dim shearing current wash; drops any scene into a glowing night sea or bioluminescent bay.

style.doc: sea_sparkle=cyan-green / noctiluca=deep blue / firefly_squid=electric blue, dense / ghost=pale white-green, eerie
